title: ThreatBook EASM Data Pack
description: One reporting period of EASM deliverables in machine-readable form. Produced by easm_convert.py (or directly by the delivery team). Consumed by the Flocks EASM workspace ingest workflow. Field semantics are documented in the portal design notes.
$comment: v1.0 errata 2026-09-08: every property that is not listed in its parent's `required` may also be null (the converter emits null for empty cells); aggregate maps keyed by data values (hosts, ports, forums...) are open objects.
